title: Pre-Construction Termite Treatment in Pune
intro: Protect your new building in Pune from termite infestation with professional pre-construction anti-termite treatment. For new Pune homes and development projects, preventive soil treatment is planned around foundation work, filling, flooring and accessible external areas in coordination with the builder.

definition: Pre-construction anti-termite treatment is a preventive process carried out during construction to help protect your building from subterranean termites.
